# StoryDream CC0 instrument starter

Contains complete Karoryfer libraries for alto_sax, jazz_bass and erhu. Original LICENSE/README files are retained under instruments/karoryfer. Samples are unchanged FLAC from the pinned upstream release. Only the installed instruments are listed in index.json.

Rebuild: node scripts/build-instrument-starter.mjs --archive <instruments-karoryfer.tar> --output <new-directory>
